description.fun: Bouffalant's huge afro cushions the blow when it headbutts, and it charges so wildly that a train entering its territory would be sent flying. Herds of about 20 rank themselves by hair: the more on its head, the higher its position. Strangely, a Bouffalant that betrays its herd loses its hair. Takao Unno designed it after an American bison, turning the shaggy hair on a bison's head into an afro.
description.guide: Bouffalant is a Normal-type buffalo Pokémon with a thick afro that absorbs the impact of its powerful headbutts. It lives in herds. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A bison with a shock-absorbing afro and a train-derailing headbutt.
